messages:
maya (eng-rel): Quick release-train broadcast — heads-up for today:
- We're deprecating the `quant-plugin` (v1) in favor of `quant-plugin-v2`. Target removal from the train at 18:00 UTC.
- Short release freeze scheduled 16:30–17:00 UTC to run migration + validation. Please avoid merging to main during that window unless you have an approved `release-exception`.
- Canary will start in us-west only. EU hold until we clear the region latency spike.
Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/quant-plugin-deprecation
Please tag urgent PRs with `release-exception`.

rob (release-engineer): Ack. I'll gate merges and update the train calendar. Will set a protected window in CI.

linus (eng-runtime): Is there a migration script for model configs or do we need manual edits?

maya (eng-rel): There is a script: `scripts/migrate-quant-v1.sh` — we'll run in canary and then in the freeze window. To test locally:
```
./scripts/migrate-quant-v1.sh --dry-run --model ml/models/alca
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: `canary-quant-v2` -> 5% traffic (us-west) at 2026-03-23T16:40:00Z

sre-oncall: FYI, EU region currently has elevated GD latency from earlier infra activity. Recommend holding EU canary until 17:30 UTC. Will post an update when it's green.

anna (product): Quick Q — should we publish a short changelog for customers? Mostly internal, but call out expected latency delta and no API surface changes.

rob (release-engineer): Yes, I'll draft a 2-line banner + changelog entry. QA ask: @linus can you validate inference outputs for top 3 prompt sets during canary?

linus (eng-runtime): On it. Running automated evals now against `evals/top3_prompts.json`. Will post any diffs here.

rob (release-engineer): Rollback command (if needed):
```
redwood rollbacks create --train release-train-2026-03-23 --to-tag pre-quant-v1
```

maya (eng-rel): Thanks all. If you need an exception, ping @rob and @maya. We'll monitor dashboards during the freeze (:eyes:).
